$comment: Per-file, per-rule exceptions for the voice rules in content-lint.mjs. Every entry needs `file` (relative to packages/website; a trailing slash allows a directory), `rule` (a VOICE-* rule id) and a non-empty `reason`. Optional `phrase` narrows the entry to one phrase id from the rule tables. An entry without a reason fails the lint.

entries.reason: Two answer options use the word inside the claim the learner must judge; rewording an option could change which answer is correct, so the option texts stay verbatim.
The chapter quotes a customer reply the model drafts. Sie is the correct form in German business correspondence, so the example keeps it while the chapter around it stays Du.
A glossary example quotes a formal notice addressed to a third party, where Sie is correct; the surrounding reference text stays Du.
